creativeThesis: A tanker unable to deliver itself becomes a shared vessel for getting its fuel to Malta.
viewerExperience: Real formation → besieged destination → fuel cargo → attacks and actual deck damage → powerless flooding hull → struggling tow → destroyers join → real arrival and discharge → battered hull, surviving fuel, continued air operations.
emotionalTarget: Surprise at the real arrangement, tension from physical difficulty, satisfaction from understanding the cargo delivery.
visualThesis: Archive-authenticated rescue, with a large oblique volumetric tanker carried continuously from lost propulsion through a yawing tow to destroyers secured alongside and towing assistance ahead. Return to the same battered hull with surviving fuel highlighted and a symbolic aircraft connection.

decisions.treatment: Existing documentary archive with a large oblique original rescue reconstruction
decisions.rationale: Different evidence types answer different questions: actual ship, physical relationship, destination and surviving fuel.

decisions.treatment: Monochrome unaltered official photographs; deep green-grey sea and limestone chart, muted brass fuel in original reconstruction. Manrope captions and restrained Space Grotesk identifiers. V2 uses deck, hull depth and superstructure planes, deliberate camera pullback to show assisting vessels, and an intact battered tanker; no literal lifting or physical simulation claim.
decisions.rationale: Photographs retain historical identity; contemporary drawings are visibly distinct. No sepia war preset, fake grain, invented damage footage or decorative battle action.

decisions.treatment: Local Kokoro af_heart speed1; 98words, lucid and measured, restrained urgency.
decisions.rationale: Established primary voice; no war-announcer acting or routine narrator audition.

decisions.treatment: Manrope600 at54px, mixed case, natural speech phrases on quiet lower field; short supporting labels36–56px, outside caption space.
decisions.rationale: Archive and moving ships need visual room; complete exact narration remains readable without a second wall of prose.

decisions.treatment: Original low sea-like filtered texture and restrained nonliteral tension tone; soften under spatial explanation, slight release on arrival.
decisions.rationale: No unlicensed music, historical radio, invented gunfire or authentic-recording claim. Voice leads.

decisions.treatment: Approximately35–50seconds from measured complete takes; pause on joined formation and fuel payoff.
decisions.rationale: Each cut advances destination, damage, towing problem, solution or delivery; no padding or constant camera motion.

decisions.treatment: This tanker reached Malta with a warship lashed to each side.
decisions.rationale: Show real three-ship relationship immediately, then explain why it was necessary.

decisions.treatment: 1080x1920at30fps; critical objects/labels within conservative local insets, full-bleed noncritical sea/archive atmosphere.
decisions.rationale: Candidate preflight all four; unknown native UI/crops/device remain explicit. No variants/packages at this stage.

risks: Some archival scans low resolution; preserve their visible texture without AI restoration/fabrication.
Source ship identity/cargo-total disagreements excluded from exact narration.
